argument_markdown:
## Argument

### 0. Verified inputs and established facts

ATT-0066, dual-confirmed by REV-0110 and REV-0116, supplies: deg L=6, χ(L)=1, h^0(L)=1+h^0(M) with M=ω^{⊗2}⊗W_5^∨ of degree 4 (CLM-0066-1); under the weak CE normalization, L≅ω(-D) and h^0(L)∈{3,4} (CLM-0066-2); the closed Abel–Jacobi incidence I=Hilb^6×_{Pic^6}B with I×_B B_k ≅ P((π_*L|_{B_k})^∨) on each reduced constant-h^0 stratum (CLM-0066-4, CLM-0066-5); and the stack-level finite étale S_6-torsor of ordered distinct support over the reduced-support open, with tilde I=Z_ev on Conf_6 (CLM-0066-6).

Established working-context facts (primary WORKING-C66-COMP-COMP) used directly: on the balanced locus h^0(O(D))=2 and h^0(L)=3 with no fibrewise jumping (hyperelliptic degree-four covers cannot have F≅O(4)⊕O(5)); over a reduced balanced base the Abel–Jacobi incidence is a Zariski-locally trivial P^2-bundle; for each p one has h^0(L(-2p))≥1, so every fibre |L_b| contains a nonreduced divisor; if a reduced member exists then the reduced-support locus is a nonempty proper open in irreducible |L_b|≅P^2; base point of |L| at p (when h^0(L)=3) iff h^0(O(D+p))=3.

Packet FND-0130 (corroborated): a base point of L=ω(-D) with h^0(D)=2 forces a smooth plane quintic whose tetragonal pencil is projection from the base point and has unbalanced CE relations, hence lies outside the balanced locus.

### 1. Base-point-freeness (proved)

Fix a geometric balanced fibre with the weak normalization, so L≅ω(-D) and h^0(D)=2, h^0(L)=3. Suppose p is a base point of |L|. The established criterion gives h^0(O(D+p))=3. Then |D+p| is a g^2_5. A g^2_5 with a base point would yield a g^2_4 and Clifford equality, forcing hyperellipticity; but a hyperelliptic genus-6 curve admits no base-point-free pencil of degree 4 with h^0=2, so |D+p| is base-point-free. Degree 5 is prime, so the map C→P^2 is birational onto a plane quintic of arithmetic genus 6, hence C is a smooth plane quintic, D≅H-p, and gamma is projection from p. By FND-0130 this cover has unbalanced CE relations and is excluded from the balanced locus, a contradiction. (The h^0(D)=3 branch cannot occur on a balanced fibre by the established hyperelliptic exclusion; separately, a base point there would demand a g^3_5, contradicting Clifford.) Therefore |L| is base-point-free on every balanced geometric fibre.

### 2. Reduced member via characteristic-zero Bertini (proved)

Base-point-freeness of the complete g^2_6 |L| defines a morphism φ_L:C→P^2 whose image spans P^2: if the image lay in a line then H^0(O_{P^2}(1))→H^0(L) would factor through a 2-dimensional space, contradicting h^0(L)=3. In characteristic zero, Bertini’s theorem for a nondegenerate curve in P^2 asserts that a general hyperplane meets the image transversely in reduced points; pulling back, a general member of |L| is a reduced effective divisor of degree 6. Equivalently, the locus of hyperplanes tangent to φ_L(C) is a proper closed subset of the dual P^2 (the dual curve), so its complement is nonempty and Zariski open.

### 3. Fibrewise reduced/nonreduced decomposition (proved)

Thus |L_b| contains a reduced member. Combined with the established jet-kernel fact that every fibre also contains a nonreduced member, the reduced-support open U_b is a nonempty proper open subset of irreducible |L_b|≅P^2, hence Zariski dense, and its complement is a nonempty proper closed subset. This does not use χ(L)=1 beyond the already-established nonemptiness of the full Abel–Jacobi fibre; the reduced-support cut is discharged by base-point-freeness plus Bertini.

### 4. Ordered Conf_6 incidence (proved)

By ATT-0066 (H4)/CLM-0066-6, ordering six distinct support points realizes a finite étale S_6-torsor over the reduced-support open. Since U_b is nonempty of dimension 2, the ordered Conf_6 incidence over b is nonempty of pure dimension 2.

### 5. Component-decomposition test

Proposed balanced residual decompositions that posit an empty reduced-support piece, or an empty ordered Conf_6 piece, on some balanced geometric fibre are therefore false. The correct fibrewise cut of the residual P^2 is into a dense open reduced-support stratum and a nonempty proper closed nonreduced stratum; both are present on every balanced fibre. No promotion of 15+2=17 to a pure-codimension-4 image in M_{6,6} is made (blocked by the working-context constraints on open subsets of P^2-bundles and on constructible-image purity).

### Separation of status

Proved: base-point-freeness on balanced normalized fibres; nonempty dense reduced-support open in every |L_b|; nonempty pure-dimension-2 ordered Conf_6 incidence on every balanced geometric fibre; falsity of empty-reduced-support proposed decompositions.

Source-backed: ATT-0066 with REV-0110 and REV-0116; FND-0130; FND-0105 (normalization as hypothesis); SRC-0004 degrees as used by ATT-0066.

Computational hypotheses: none.

Gaps retained: relative density over a general base; monodromy image in S_6; components of B; all image/codimension/closure/stabilizer/Gysin data in M_{6,6}; Tate support and RED-0001.

claims.justification: A base point forces h^0(D+p)=3. With the established balanced value h^0(D)=2 this yields a base-point-free birational g^2_5, hence a smooth plane quintic with gamma the projection from p. FND-0130 excludes all such covers from the balanced locus. The argument does not infer base-point-freeness from h^0(L)=3 alone.
claims.statement: On every geometric fibre of a balanced genus-6 degree-4 CE family satisfying the weak CE normalization of ATT-0066, the residual system |L| with L=W_5⊗ω^{-1}≅ω(-D) is base-point-free.

claims.justification: CLM-0090-1 plus characteristic-zero Bertini for the spanning morphism φ_L:C→P^2 produce a reduced member. The established 2-jet kernel fact supplies a nonreduced member. A nonempty proper open in irreducible P^2 is dense and not closed. This route deliberately avoids the blocked inference from χ(L)=1 alone.
claims.statement: On every such fibre, the reduced-support open U_b⊂|L_b|≅P^2 is a nonempty Zariski-dense open, and the nonreduced locus is a nonempty proper closed subset.

claims.justification: ATT-0066/CLM-0066-6 realizes Conf_6→U as a finite étale S_6-torsor at stack level; CLM-0090-2 makes U_b nonempty of dimension 2, and finite étale maps preserve dimension.
claims.statement: On every such fibre the ordered Conf_6 incidence is nonempty of pure dimension 2.

claims.justification: Immediate from CLM-0090-2 and CLM-0090-3. No image-dimension or purity claim in M_{6,6} is asserted.
claims.statement: Every proposed balanced residual component decomposition that assigns an empty reduced-support or empty ordered Conf_6 piece to some balanced geometric fibre is false.

novelty_claims: Closes the fibrewise reduced-support/Conf_6 nonemptiness obligation left open after the dual-confirmed H0 stratification and the established balanced constancy of h^0(L)=3, by a base-point-freeness-plus-Bertini argument that does not use the blocked χ(L)=1 route.
Gives an explicit negative test of proposed residual component decompositions that posit empty reduced-support pieces on balanced fibres, while refusing any pure-codimension-4 image claim in M_{6,6}.

proof_dependencies.role: Verified C66-GEO-H0 dependency; CLM-0066-1 through CLM-0066-6 used within reduced-base, normalization, and Conf_6 scope.
Second independent confirmation of ATT-0066, including the reducedness caveat for Grauert.
Plane-quintic tetragonal pencils are CE-unbalanced and cannot witness base points on the balanced locus.
Weak CE relative-canonical normalization retained as an explicit hypothesis.

summary: Tests proposed balanced residual component decompositions at the reduced-support cut. Under the dual-confirmed H0 package plus weak normalization, every balanced geometric fibre has base-point-free |L|≅P^2; characteristic-zero Bertini supplies a reduced six-point member, so the reduced-support open is nonempty and dense and the ordered Conf_6 incidence is nonempty of dimension 2. Proposed decompositions with an empty reduced-support piece on some balanced fibre are therefore false. No M_{6,6} image or Tate claim is made.

theorem_scope.base: reduced locally Noetherian schemes over a characteristic-zero field
theorem_scope.dependency_scope: ATT-0066 used exactly as dual-confirmed by REV-0110 and REV-0116; constancy h^0(L)=3 on the balanced locus is taken from the established working-context facts that already exclude hyperelliptic fibres from balancedness
theorem_scope.exclusions: nonreduced bases; relative (total-space) density of reduced support over a general base; S_6 monodromy image; irreducibility of B; image dimension/codimension/closure/stabilizers/lci/Gysin in M_{6,6}; unbalanced CE strata; all Hodge/Tate conclusions and RED-0001
theorem_scope.generality: fibrewise balanced tetragonal Casnati–Ekedahl families with the ATT-0066 canonical filtered quotient W_5 and the weak CE relative-canonical normalization

theorem_statement: Let k be a field of characteristic zero and let B be a reduced locally Noetherian k-scheme carrying a smooth proper curve family pi:C->B with geometrically connected genus-6 fibres together with a finite flat degree-four map gamma:C->P^1_B whose Casnati–Ekedahl relations bundle is fibrewise balanced, F_b ≅ O(4)⊕O(5). Use the canonical filtered quotient W_5 of ATT-0066 (dual-confirmed by REV-0110 and REV-0116) and put L=W_5⊗ω_{C/B}^{-1}. Assume the weak CE relative-canonical normalization of ATT-0066/FND-0105 fibrewise, so L_b ≅ ω_{C_b}(-D_b) with D_b a fibre of gamma_b. Then on every geometric fibre: (R1) |L_b| is a base-point-free complete g^2_6 (in particular h^0(L_b)=3); (R2) writing |L_b|≅P^2 for the fibre of the closed Abel–Jacobi incidence I=Hilb^6(C/B)×_{Pic^6(C/B)}B, the reduced-support open U_b⊂|L_b| of divisors with six pairwise-distinct points is a nonempty Zariski-dense open, and its complement (the nonreduced locus) is a nonempty proper closed subset; (R3) the ordered Conf_6 incidence over b is therefore nonempty of pure dimension 2. Consequently every proposed balanced residual component decomposition that assigns an empty reduced-support (or empty ordered Conf_6) piece to some balanced geometric fibre is false. No claim is made about image dimension, purity, or codimension in M_{6,6}, about S_6 monodromy, or about RED-0001.
